rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Speaker reported receipt that day from Prime Minister Abe (安倍内閣総理大臣) of notice that the cabinet had decided to resign en masse.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The House of Representatives designated 福田康夫 as Prime Minister on 25 September 2007: 338 of 477 votes (majority 239); 小沢一郎 117, 志位和夫 9, 福島みずほ 7, 綿貫民輔 5, 1 invalid (478 name cards, one counted as abstention).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: After a recess (13:36-15:32) the Speaker reported that the House of Councillors had notified its designation of 小沢一郎 and, the two Houses' decisions differing, requested a joint committee; ten members were named.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: On the joint committee's report of no agreement, the Speaker declared that under Constitution art. 67(2) the House of Representatives' designation (福田康夫) had become the Diet's resolution and would be reported to the Emperor forthwith under Diet Law art. 65(2); sitting adjourned 17:36.

locator.speaker: 笹川堯; 河野洋平 (議長)
